headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 广州有银行住房商贷利率最低可至2.7% 分析人士：更像针对特定人群的“价格战”
headlines.summary: 目前多数城市已经取消了住房贷款利率下限，但仍维持在3%以上。广州此前便有银行将住房贷款下调至3%以下，随后均又调回3%。不过，汇丰银行广州分行称，住房贷款利率最低可至2.7%。“未来银行个人住房贷款利率大体上也不会降，3%基本上是底线了，只能说只针对部分特定客户可以给到2.7%。”上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进对记者表示，此类最低利率门槛很高，并非人人都能享受，更像是一种针对特定人群的“价格战”。（每经）

headlines.title_en: Some Guangzhou banks' mortgage rates for commercial housing can be as low as 2.7%; analysts say it's more like a 'price war' targeting specific groups
headlines.summary_en: Most cities have already removed the floor on housing loan rates, but rates remain above 3%. In Guangzhou, some banks had previously lowered housing loans below 3%, but all later reverted to 3%. However, HSBC's Guangzhou branch said housing loan rates can go as low as 2.7%. "In the future, banks' individual housing loan rates will generally not drop either; 3% is basically the bottom line. Only for certain specific clients can 2.7% be offered." Yan Yuejin, deputy director of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute, told reporters that such minimum rate thresholds are very high and not accessible to everyone, more like a "price war" targeting specific groups. (NBD)

headlines.title: 2026年下半年中国人民银行广东省分行工作会议暨广东外汇管理工作会议召开

headlines.title_en: The PBOC Guangdong Provincial Branch 2026 H2 work conference and Guangdong foreign exchange management work meeting were held
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: On August 4, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China held its 2026 H2 work conference and Guangdong foreign exchange management work meeting. The meeting emphasized continuing to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to help Guangdong's economy maintain growth momentum; stepping up support for key areas and weak links to improve the quality and efficiency of financial services to the real economy; continuing to deepen foreign exchange management reform to enhance the facilitation of cross-border trade and investment financing; and fully exercising functions of maintaining financial stability and macroprudential management to hold the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks. The meeting required: first, advancing institutional opening in the foreign exchange field to promote trade and investment facilitation; second, vigorously optimizing foreign exchange services to support high-quality development of the foreign-related economy; third, strengthening foreign exchange business supervision to build a breakwater against external shocks.

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson answers questions on countermeasures against a series of negative U.S. FCC and DHS measures related to China
headlines.summary_en: The FCC's measures and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's listing of relevant entities on the so-called "Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List" seriously violate the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and seriously damage China's legitimate rights and interests. China has no choice but to take necessary countermeasures in response, including: strengthening export controls on drones and their key components and technology to the U.S., suspending factory follow-up inspections conducted by U.S. certification bodies designated by China's compulsory product certification institutions, placing American Compliance Testing Company on the countermeasures list, launching a foreign trade national security investigation into imported printing, copying and office equipment, and placing 6 U.S. entities on the countermeasures list, among others.

headlines.title: 广西：以旧换新政策发力 智能家电消费升温
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月5日讯，国家补贴叠加地方扩补政策落地，恰逢暑期消费旺季，广西家电市场迎来新一轮消费热潮。走访中发现，以旧换新政策持续加力，智能家电加速走进千家万户，消费升级态势明显。今年以来，广西消费品以旧换新累计补贴数码和智能产品206.1万台、汽车9.5万辆、家电255.3万台，补贴资金29.6亿元，拉动商品销售额267亿元。其中，县域参与主体占比达45.2%，农村地区享受补贴金额占比达37.1%，乡村消费潜力正在加速释放。北京工商大学商业经济研究所所长洪涛表示，以旧换新在政策持续托底的基础上，升级为“需求+体验”双轮驱动。国家、地方、企业构建起三重补贴

headlines.title_en: Guangxi: Trade-in policy gains momentum, boosting smart home appliance consumption
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: With national subsidies combined with local expansion policies taking effect, coinciding with the summer consumption peak season, Guangxi's home appliance market is experiencing a new round of consumption boom. Surveys found that the trade-in policy continues to be strengthened, smart home appliances are increasingly entering households, and the consumption upgrade trend is evident. Since the beginning of this year, Guangxi's consumer goods trade-in program has subsidized a cumulative 2.061 million digital and smart products, 95,000 vehicles, and 2.553 million home appliances, with subsidy funds of 2.96 billion yuan, driving merchandise sales of 26.7 billion yuan. Among these, county-level participants account for 45.2%, and rural areas account for 37.1% of subsidy amounts, with rural consumption potential rapidly being released. Hong Tao, director of the Commercial Economics Research Institute at Beijing Technology and Business University, stated that trade-in has upgraded to a "demand + experience" dual-driver model based on continued policy support. National, local and enterprise levels have built a triple subsidy...

headlines.title: 两部门预拨3.3亿元支持8省（市）做好自然灾害应急抢险救灾工作
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月5日讯，当前，我国处于“七下八上”主汛期，东北、西南、西北等南北方多地反复遭遇持续性强降雨，引发洪涝、地质灾害，造成人员伤亡和房屋倒损。为深入贯彻落实习近平总书记关于防汛抗旱工作的重要指示精神，8月5日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨3.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持黑龙江、辽宁、吉林、重庆、四川、贵州、云南、陕西等8省（市）开展自然灾害应急抢险救灾工作，重点做好搜救转移安置受灾人员、排危除险等应急处置、次生灾害隐患排查整治、倒损民房修复等工作,最大限度减少灾害损失。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries pre-allocated 330 million yuan to support 8 provinces (cities) in natural disaster emergency response and relief work
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: Currently, China is in the main flood season of "late July to early August," with continuous heavy rainfall repeatedly hitting multiple regions in the north and south, including the northeast, southwest and northwest, triggering floods and geological disasters, causing casualties and housing damage. To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on flood and drought prevention work, on August 5, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 330 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support 8 provinces (municipalities) including Heilongjiang, Liaoning, Jilin, Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan and Shaanxi in carrying out emergency disaster relief work, with focus on search, rescue, transfer and resettlement of affected people, hazard removal and emergency response, inspection and rectification of secondary disaster risks, and repair of damaged homes, to minimize disaster losses.

headlines.title: 商务部：对相关进口打印复印办公设备发起对外贸易国家安全立案调查
headlines.summary: 依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定，为了维护对外贸易秩序，商务部可以自行或者会同国务院其他有关部门，就对外贸易中有关国家安全利益的事项进行调查。初步信息显示，装有外国系统软件的进口打印复印办公设备可能影响对外贸易中的国家安全利益，符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定的情形。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Launch of national security investigation into imports of printing and copying office equipment
headlines.summary_en: Pursuant to Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, in order to maintain foreign trade order, the Ministry of Commerce may, on its own or together with other relevant State Council departments, investigate matters concerning national security interests in foreign trade. Preliminary information shows that imported printing, copying and office equipment installed with foreign system software may affect national security interests in foreign trade, conforming to the circumstances stipulated in Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China.

headlines.title: 商务部：加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制
headlines.summary: 根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，为维护国家安全和利益、履行防扩散等国际义务，决定加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制。现将有关事项公告如下：对列入《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》的无人机及其关键零部件、相关技术对美国出口，逐案从严审核，不适用许可便利措施。本公告自公布之日起正式实施。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Strengthening export controls on dual-use items related to drones to the U.S.
headlines.summary_en: In accordance with the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items and other relevant laws and regulations, to safeguard national security and interests and fulfill international obligations such as non-proliferation, it is decided to strengthen export controls on drone-related dual-use items to the United States. The relevant matters are hereby announced as follows: export of drones and their key components and related technologies listed in the "Dual-Use Items Export Control List of the People's Republic of China" to the United States shall be strictly reviewed on a case-by-case basis, and licensing facilitation measures shall not apply. This announcement takes effect from the date of publication.

headlines.title: *ST卓然：2026年8月6日起继续实施财务类退市风险警示及实施其他风险警示
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月5日讯，*ST卓然公告，因公司2025年度财务报告被天职国际出具无法表示意见的审计报告，触及《股票上市规则》第12.4.2条规定，上海证券交易所将对公司股票继续实施财务类退市风险警示；因公司2025年度财务报告内部控制被天职国际出具否定意见的审计报告，触及第12.9.1条相关规定，将对公司股票实施其他风险警示。公司股票自2026年8月6日起继续实施财务类退市风险警示并实施其他风险警示，证券简称仍为“*ST卓然”，证券代码仍为“688121”，日涨跌幅限制仍为20%。

headlines.title_en: *ST Zhuoran: From August 6, 2026, continues to implement financial-type delisting risk warning and other risk warnings
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: *ST Zhuoran announced that because the company's 2025 annual financial report was issued with a disclaimer of opinion audit report by Tianzhi International, triggering the provisions of Article 12.4.2 of the Stock Listing Rules, the Shanghai Stock Exchange will continue to impose financial delisting risk warning on the company's shares; because the company's 2025 internal control over financial reporting was issued with an adverse opinion audit report by Tianzhi International, triggering the relevant provisions of Article 12.9.1, an other risk warning will be imposed on the company's shares. The company's shares will continue to be subject to financial delisting risk warning and other risk warning from August 6, 2026. The securities abbreviation remains "*ST Zhuoran," the securities code remains "688121," and the daily price limit remains 20%.

headlines.title: 印尼央行：人民币占本币交易逾八成 拟进一步扩大对华结算合作
headlines.summary: 【印尼央行：人民币占本币交易逾八成 拟进一步扩大对华结算合作】印尼央行计划近期进一步落实并扩大与中国内地及香港的本币交易(LCT)合作，以建立完整的印尼盾与人民币货币及外汇市场生态。印尼央行表示，2026年6月，印尼盾与人民币交易约占LCT交易总额的81%。这一增长“表明，印尼盾与人民币直接结算作为经由第三方货币进行交易的替代方式，重要性正日益上升”。

headlines.title_en: Indonesia's central bank: RMB accounts for over 80% of local currency transactions, plans to further expand settlement cooperation with China
headlines.summary_en: Indonesia Central Bank: RMB Accounts for Over 80% of Local Currency Transactions; Plans to Expand Settlement Cooperation with China. Indonesia's central bank plans to further implement and expand local currency transaction (LCT) cooperation with mainland China and Hong Kong in the near term, aiming to build a complete IDR-RMB currency and forex market ecosystem. The central bank stated that in June 2026, IDR-RMB transactions accounted for approximately 81% of total LCT transactions. This growth "indicates that direct settlement between the IDR and RMB is increasingly important as an alternative to transactions conducted via third-party currencies."
